SELECT t1.question_answer_id, t2.subject_name, t1.question_type, t1.question_title, t1.question_difficulty, t1.user_answer, t1.right_answer, t1.question_score, t1.`explain`, t1.`option` FROM ms_question_answer AS t1 LEFT JOIN ms_subjects AS t2 ON t1.subject_id = t2.subject_id
t1.user_id = #{userId} AND t1.del_flag = 0 AND t1.`status` = 2
AND t1.subject_id=#{subjectId}
ORDER BY t1.create_time DESC
